title: Nomilin Attenuates Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Inflammatory Response by Binding with Myeloid Differentiation Protein-2.
authors: Chen, Yuting; Guo, Song; Chen, Guirong; Liu, Chang; Zhang, Mingbo; Wang, Xiaobo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柠檬苦素类化合物与MD-2蛋白结合的抗炎机制，虽涉及分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Nomilin shows anti-inflammatory activity by inhibiting the activation of the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR 4)/NF-kappaB pathway. However, the key target of the anti-inflammatory activity of nomilin has not been elaborated and needs further exploration. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the drug potential of nomilin and its ability to target myeloid differentiation protein 2 (MD-2) as a mechanism underlying the anti-inflammatory activity of nomilin on the lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB signaling pathways. METHODS: The methods of ForteBio and molecular docking were used to investigate the internation between MD-2 and nomilin. 3-(4,5)-Dimethyl-thiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyl tetrazolium bromide experiment was performed to test the effect of nomilin on cell viability. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, real-time polymerase chain reaction, and Western blot experiments were carried out to assess the anti-inflammatory activity and possible mechanism of nomilin in vitro. RESULTS: The results indicated that nomilin exhibited binding affinity with MD-2. Nomilin significantly reduced the release and expression of NO, IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta induced by LPS in vitro. It inhibited the expression of LPS-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB signaling pathway proteins, such as TLR4, Myd88, P65, P-P65, and iNOS. CONCLUSION: Our results suggested that nomilin had therapeutic potential and was bound to MD-2. Nomilin exhibited anti-inflammatory activity by binding to the key protein MD-2 and inhibiting the LPS-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：诺米林通过抑制Toll样受体4（TLR 4）/NF-kappaB通路的激活显示出抗炎活性。然而，诺米林抗炎活性的关键靶点尚未阐明，需进一步探索。目的：本研究旨在评估诺米林的药物潜力及其靶向髓系分化蛋白2（MD-2）的能力，作为诺米林对脂多糖（LPS）-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB信号通路抗炎活性的机制。方法：采用ForteBio和分子对接方法研究MD-2与诺米林之间的相互作用。通过3-(4,5)-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物实验检测诺米林对细胞活力的影响。采用酶联免疫吸附试验、实时聚合酶链反应和Western blot实验评估诺米林在体外的抗炎活性及可能机制。结果：结果表明，诺米林与MD-2具有结合亲和力。诺米林显著降低了LPS在体外诱导的NO、IL-6、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta的释放和表达。它抑制了LPS-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB信号通路蛋白（如TLR4、Myd88、P65、P-P65和iNOS）的表达。结论：我们的结果表明，诺米林具有治疗潜力，并与MD-2结合。诺米林通过结合关键蛋白MD-2并抑制LPS-TLR4/MD-2-NF-kappaB信号通路表现出抗炎活性。
